title: AnvilCap
description: Removes "Too Expensive" and lets you configure max anvil XP cost.
body:
✨ Overview
AnvilCap enhances the vanilla anvil system by removing the frustrating "Too Expensive" limitation, allowing players to freely repair, combine, and upgrade items without artificial restrictions.

---

⚙️ Core Features
- Removed the vanilla "Too Expensive" limit from anvils
- Allows high-level item repairs and enchant combinations
- Enables late-game progression without unnecessary restrictions

---

🔧 Anvil Mechanics Improvements
- Overrides the default maximum repair cost
- Ensures items remain craftable even when exceeding vanilla limits
- Prevents the anvil result from disappearing due to high XP cost
- Maintains vanilla behavior while removing limitations

---

⚙️ Configuration System
- Added configurable maximum XP cost
- Default max XP cost set to 37 levels
- Server owners can fully customize the anvil cap to fit their gameplay balance
- Automatically generates a config file on first startup

Example:
max-xp-cost: 37

---

🧠 Performance & Optimization
- Lightweight implementation with minimal performance impact
- Uses event-based logic (PrepareAnvilEvent) for efficiency
- No unnecessary tasks or background processes

---

🛠️ Compatibility
- Designed for Paper 1.21+
- Works with Spigot-based servers (not officially tested)
- Compatible with vanilla mechanics and most plugins

---

🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed issue where anvil result would not appear when exceeding cost limit
- Fixed XP cost not being applied correctly
- Fixed inconsistencies with anvil behavior at high levels

---

🚀 Use Cases
- Ideal for survival servers with long-term progression
- Perfect for RPG-style servers with high-level enchantments
- Useful for servers that want to remove frustrating vanilla limits
